Codex freshness policy.question: How long may a successful Codex observation remain current before the tile becomes stale?
When the five-minute threshold is exceeded, what should the tile show?
Codex freshness policy.answer: Keep values with an unmistakable STALE marker

Codex freshness policy.question: What should make a stale/offline Codex tile current again?
options_presented: Full read or valid sparse merge

Codex freshness policy.question: If a previous quota observation exists but the next Codex read times out or the process exits, which status should take precedence?
Codex freshness policy.answer: HOST OFFLINE, retaining stale values and observation age
